profiles.result: Individual custody endpoint and adjudication unresolved
profiles.finding: Robert Ryal Miller, Los San Patricios de 1847, printed pp362,365–368 identifies Santiago/James OLeary as second-company commander and wounded at Churubusco. Group prisoner and court-martial totals do not identify his individual conviction or release. Do not assign group June1848 discharge or September1847 sentence to him without his personal record. Existing biography and case retained pending verification; no new dates.

Handy pp288–289 February26,1864 lists Porter among twelve summoned for oath and release. Existing endpoint corroborated at order/event level; no initial admission in reviewed Porter references. August1863 mentions show already confined but are not admission dates.
